title: Valode & Pistre
description: Valode & Pistre is today one of France’s premier architecture and engineering firms. Based in Paris with a branch operating for over ten years in Beijing, the firm works on projects both in France and across the globe in Europe, Asia, the Middle East, North and Sub-Saharan Africa, Russia and Central America. Valode & Pistre’s practice focuses on very diverse scales, from developing comprehensive plans for brand new cities to designing furniture. It also includes very diverse briefs.
